preparation_warning: Loop proximity does not certify full initial orbit distance or electric/matter preparation

nominal_orbit_warning: A small positive uniform magnetic shift can pass trapping budget while destabilizing the exact nominal orbit; no unique perturbed orbit, attraction or retained degeneracy
